participation.context: Paid the quire and the ink, counted without speaking a total, and kept the list whole.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Counted four ends, sold the quire and the horn, and called the clear board repentance.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Added five and two, and did not try to add the coffer.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: tidiness will do as a sign, and she does not require the coffer's figure
relations.quote: I did not ask the figure. I asked for the sevenpence you have put down, and I have it.

story.body: You cleared the board, paid fivepence and twopence, and refused to speak the coffer's figure. You left the list unstruck, and you left Field's paper uncollected.

relations.note: tidiness will do as a sign, and she does not require the coffer's figure
relations.quote: I did not ask the figure. I asked for the sevenpence you have put down, and I have it.

title: Paid fivepence for a quire and twopence for ink

participation.context: Spoke the shoes, the list, and the baskets, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You took the shoes off before eight. You left the list unstruck, and you did not go down.

title: Took the shoes off before eight
